GardenDesign.title: GardenDesign
GardenDesign.description: A user-owned dream garden design containing plot conditions, hardscape zones, placed plants, and local visual references.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the garden owner.

title.description: Display title of the garden design.

summary.description: Concise architectural and botanical overview of the layout.

style.description: Chosen aesthetic style such as Warm Cottage, Japanese Zen, or Mediterranean.

sunlight.description: Sunlight exposure profile (e.g., Full Sun, Part Shade, Full Shade).

soilType.description: Soil composition profile (e.g., Loam, Clay, Sandy, Raised Bed Mix).

climateZone.description: Target climate or USDA hardiness zone.

hardscapeZones.description: Bounded list of up to 20 hardscape zones (paths, patios, water features) with normalized coordinates.

plants.description: Bounded list of up to 60 placed plants with normalized coordinates and botanical care metadata.

conceptVisualPath.description: Optional local app-private file path to the AI-generated garden concept visual.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the garden design was created (written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the garden design was last modified (written with FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/gardens/{gardenId}.description: User-isolated collection of dream garden designs.
